_meta.scope: Only the 712 records classified D on 2026-09-10 were re-matched. Proposals = full-name exact match (after normalization) to an ACTIVE Orphanet entity via preferred name or synonym; aliases consisting only of abbreviations were NOT used for proposals (routed to review_doc).
_meta.note: index = 0-based position in the knowledge JSON array. action fix = current code differs from matched code; add = no current code. status proposed = awaiting founder decision (not applied). severity is a mechanical string comparison of current vs proposed Orphanet names, not a medical judgement. Not applied yet. 2026-09-10 founder decisions: all C (add) approved; idx 120 added as approved (supersedes v1 rejection); B (fix) status proposed pending individual review. 2026-09-10 second round: B fix 41 → 40 approved / 1 rejected (idx 687); action remove (11) = set orpha_code to null (code does not exist in Orphanet); discovery orphanet_moved_to (4) = deprecated current code replaced by its Orphanet "Moved to" target. Obsolete codes whose "Referred to" target is a Category are KEPT (recorded in docs/kb_issues_2026-08-29.md), Non-rare-in-Europe codes KEPT. idx 474 stays on v1 approved ORPHA:79452 (Milroy). Apply only status approved. 2026-09-10 review-table round: 36 abbreviation matches approved individually (discovery abbreviation_synonym_exact), 18 rejected as new entries + 2 rejections noted on existing entries (172, 307), idx 206 pending, §1 ambiguous 235/618 rejected (keep current), §3 Non-rare 11 kept (no entries), Obsolete 6 kept (kb_issues 12), Deprecated 3 moved (620/867/915). idx 699 not yet judged. action keep = no change, listed for the record. Final (2026-09-10): idx 699 approved (14 → 1168); idx 206 rejected (no code; 73247 is non-rare/inactive). All review-table items judged.
